text:
maria: starting kubeadm cluster bring-up in eu-west2 with GPU nodepool. noticed intermittent pod networking failures after kube-proxy replacement and calico MTU tweak. kickoff checklist below, please chime in.

maria: quick notes: 8 g4dn nodes (spot + fallback on-demand), kubeadm controlplane HA (3 masters), kube-proxy -> IPVS, calico v3.25, docker runtime.

jon: got it. what symptoms of networking failures? pod-to-pod across nodes dropping or only node egress?

maria: pod-to-pod cross-node intermittent RSTs, higher retransmits, sometimes kube-system pods restart (calico-node, kube-proxy).

ravi: MTU mismatch is classic. cloud subnet uses jumbo (9000) for GPU racks but default node image uses 1500. did you set host mtu on calico?

maria: i set calico.tunnelMTU=1400 initially to play safe, then tried 9000 and failures increased. suspect fragmentation + iptables conntrack.

sneha: can we run a targeted validation script on nodes? shareable snippet:```bash
# on controlplane
kubectl get nodes -o wide
# confirm kernel NIC mtu and routes
ssh core@NODE 'ip link show' | grep mtu
# test pod-to-pod tcp throughput
kubectl run pinger --image=busybox -- sleep 3600
kubectl exec -it pinger -- wget -qO- http://<pod-ip>:8080
```

maria: run results: ip link shows MTU 9000 on host, docker0 is 1500, cni0 1500. so host nic jumbo, bridge smaller -> fragmentation.

jon: that mismatch will cause ENCAPS/DF issues. options: (A) set host bridge MTU to 9000 across node images, (B) set Calico to lower MTU and set iptables to allow fragmentation, (C) use IPIP/NO_ENCAP mode depending on routing. what's easiest for prod?

ravi: quick win is make calico.mtu = 1500 and ensure node ENI/eni settings support path MTU. longer term, align host image to 9000 for throughput. For now, set calico to 1500 and restart calico-node daemonset sequentially.

maria: will do. other items: GPU driver install needs nvidia-495 + cuda 11.7. using node feature discovery + device-plugin helm chart. also need node label strategy for spot fallback.

sneha: for device plugin, helm values we used last quarter:```yaml
nfd:
  tolerations: [{key: "spot", operator: "Exists"}]
devicePlugin:
  driver: nvidia
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
```

ops-oncall: note: autoscaler config must have mixedInstancesPolicy for spot + on-demand, scaleDownUtilizationThreshold=0.5 to avoid thrash. Also add expander: least-waste.

maria: cost calc quick check: approx g4dn.xlarge $0.526/hr spot -> avg 0.15, on-demand $0.526. for 8 nodes spot baseline monthly: 0.15*8*24*30 =~ $864. with 20% fallback to on-demand bump ~ +$252. confirm?

jon: math looks right. include networking egress premium for eu-west2 (~$0.02/GB) in TCO if large model pulls across regions.

infra-bot: deploy bot: calico helm upgrade started on 4 nodes (maria). Monitor logs: calico-node pod crashloop on node-03 -> fetching logs.

maria: saw crashloop on node-03, digging: `error: failed to allocate vxlan interface: file exists`; recreating cni bridges fixed it on that node. will roll remainder after cleaning.

ravi: safety steps before rolling: snapshot etcd, mark controlplane tolerations to keep masters steady, cordon one node at a time, drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` for gpu nodes careful.

maria: yep snapshot done. drain command I run: `kubectl drain gpu-node-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m` then apply calico change and uncordon.

sneha: add a validation gate for handoff: 1) all kube-system pods Ready, 2) sample pod ping success across 50% of cross-node pairs, 3) GPU health `nvidia-smi` present, 4) load test 95th pct latency under 120ms for inference sidecar.

maria: writing that into handoff note. handing over to ops-oncall after roll: will attach runbook link and commands executed.

ops-oncall: once ready, please ping #eng-oncall with node list + recent kubelet logs. ops will run sanity: `kubectl top nodes` and `kubectl get cs`.

jon: one more: ensure kube-proxy -> IPVS conntrack hash_max and conntrack-max tuned for high throughput with GPUs; we hit conntrack exhaustion last quarter. snippet to set sysctl via kubelet config:```yaml
kind: KubeletConfiguration
apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
serverTLSBootstrap: true
--
# sysctl via daemonset
sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
```

maria: thanks all. i'll finish calico roll with mtu 1500, device-plugin helm deploy, verify GPU driver + nfd labels, then handoff. will post final status here and tag ops-oncall. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: cluster-checker: preliminary checks passed 6/9. waiting on calico pod readiness and gpu device plugin.

maria: update 30m later: calico all ok, device plugin ok, drained+uncordoned all nodes. running validation tests now. launching p2p test across 10 pods.

ravi: ping when tests finish, will approve handoff if clean.

maria: tests passed 10/10 pod pairs, nvidia-smi present on all nodes, autoscaler tested by artificially creating load -> scale event fired to fallback group. creating final runbook snippet and handing to ops.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. please attach runbook + list of config diffs. scheduling handoff meeting in 30m. :calendar:
